The proposal was unanimously passed by the members present in the committee. The details of this vote are in the "Votes" section of this page. The Committee then discussed the matter raised by North Galolhu MP Mohamed Ibrahim regarding the Parole Board’s decision to release an individual who had been sentenced to 25 years in prison. The Committee decided to examine the matter further and write to the Parole Board to request additional information. This was proposed by Faresmathodha constituency member ashraf Rasheed, and seconded by Vilufushi constituency member hassan waheed. The proposal was unanimously passed by the members present in the committee. The details of this vote are in the "Votes" section of this page. The Committee then discussed two letters received from individuals expressing concerns regarding the judicial system and requesting an opportunity to discuss their concerns with the Committee members. Following the discussion, the Committee decided that the Chairperson would meet with both individuals to hear their concerns and subsequently determine whether any further action by the Committee would be necessary. This was proposed by South Hithadhoo constituency member Ibrahim Nazil and seconded by Funadhoo constituency member Mohamed Mamdhooh. The proposal was unanimously passed by the members present in the committee. The details of this vote are in the "Votes" section of this page. In today’s meeting, committee discussed the letter received from the law students and the letter received from North Feydhoo Constituency Member Ismail Nizar regarding the Second Amendment to the "Minimum Standards on Entry Criteria, Prescribed Learning Outcomes and Statement of Prescribed Knowledge for Qualifying Law Degrees". Both letters highlight a lot of concerns regarding the 2nd amendment. In the previous meeting committee had decided to invite Maldives Bar Council for additional information, therefore, in this meeting the committee decided to meet them on 18 th October 2026. This was proposed by South Hithadhoo constituency member Ibrahim Nazil and seconded the north Funadhoo constituency member Mohamed Mamdhooh. The proposal was unanimously passed by the members present in the committee. The details of this vote are in the "Votes" section of this page.

meetings.summary: In Today’s meeting, the committee discussed the Committee report on the issue sent to committee regarding Tax Appeal Tribunal. After discussing the committee decided to submit the report to Majlis for consideration with three proposals from the Committee. The proposals are as below; 1. In the issue submitted to the committee, there had been allegations on misused of Tribunal Members position and allegation of corruption against some members, therefore committee proposes to ask Anti-Corruption commission to investigate these allegations. 2. Since the President and Vice President of Tax Appeal Tribunal has agreed in the committee meeting that the Tribunal is functioning in more space than is required, and since the Committee’s visit to the Tribunal has also shown that a larger portion of space has not been used, the committee proposes that the Tribunal should be asked to coordinate with the authorities in this regard to minimize the financial loss to the state. 3. As per the existing regulation of the Tribunal regarding the selection of the bench and the appointment of a person to preside over the bench, the president of the tribunal has the power to recommend who will be on the bench depending on the nature of the case. Since there seems to be a possibility of public questioning regarding as to cases will be dealt fairly. Therefore, committee proposed the regulation to be amended. This was proposed by Holhudhoo Constituency Member AbdulSattar Mohamed and seconded by Kurendhoo Constituency Member Shamin Habeeb. The voting details for this proposal are as follows.
